reason: I'm abroad and my admin's spreadsheet is always a week behind, so I end up scrolling the group chat at midnight trying to work out what was spent on the build. A sheet that fills itself and flags duplicates and wrong totals is exactly what I want, the price is nothing next to one padded invoice, and the 30 free documents cost me nothing to find out.
objection: Half the receipts from site are faded thermal paper or handwritten nota from a local toko in Indonesian. If the bot misreads amounts on those, my admin still has to check every row and I'm paying for a second spreadsheet to fix.
would_change_my_mind: If more than a few of the first 30 receipts from my own site come out with wrong amounts or suppliers, I drop it and stay with the admin.
